name: create table as
sql: CREATE TABLE stolen AS SELECT * FROM reviews

name: alter table
sql: ALTER TABLE movies ADD COLUMN x TEXT

name: multi-statement
sql: SELECT title FROM movies; DROP TABLE movies

name: multi-statement select
sql: SELECT title FROM movies; SELECT text FROM reviews

name: comment-hidden statement
sql: SELECT title FROM movies;/**/DROP TABLE movies

name: statement after line comment newline
sql:
SELECT title FROM movies --
; DELETE FROM reviews

name: select into
sql: SELECT title INTO stolen FROM movies

name: hidden column in where
sql: SELECT reviewer FROM reviews WHERE reviewer_email LIKE '%@%'

name: hidden column via qualified star
sql: SELECT r.* FROM reviews AS r

name: hidden column via subquery star
sql: SELECT x.* FROM (SELECT * FROM reviews) AS x

name: alias shadowing hidden column
sql: SELECT 1 AS reviewer_email, reviewer_email FROM reviews

name: recursive cte bomb
sql: WITH RECURSIVE c(x) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT x + 1 FROM c) SELECT x FROM c

name: recursive cte bomb lowercase
sql: with recursive r(n) as (select 1 union all select n*2 from r) select count(*) from r

name: cartesian join bomb
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM movies a, movies b, movies c, movies d, movies e

name: positional placeholder
sql: SELECT title FROM movies WHERE id = ?

name: create trigger
sql: CREATE TRIGGER t AFTER INSERT ON movies BEGIN DELETE FROM reviews; END

name: cte with dml
sql: WITH x AS (DELETE FROM reviews RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM x
